description: A squat refuelling bowser lashed to the deck at the pad's edge: a scuffed avgas tank on a wheeled cradle, a coiled grounding cable, and a dead-man nozzle racked in a spring clip. A brass placard reads AVGAS 100LL · GROUND BEFORE FUELLING. It serves the helideck and tops off anything with a tank; fill a container here, or refuel an aircraft parked on the pad.
name: the fuel bowser
